Elk, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. CIMT (RM Team 2). CIMT is also managing the 
Gold Mountain incident. Seven miles northwest of Lake City, CO. Timber, brush and grass. Active fire behavior 
with flanking, backing and single tree torching. Numerous structures threatened. Evacuations, area, road and 
trail closures in effect. Precipitation occurred over the fire area yesterday. 
 
Gold Mountain, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. Two miles north of Ouray, CO. Grass, 
brush and timber. Active fire behavior with flanking, backing and single tree torching. Energy infrastructure 
threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Precipitation occurred over the fire area yesterday. 
 
Weiser Knoll, Wind River/Bighorn Basin District, BLM. Thirteen miles southeast of Lander, WY. Grass, brush 
and timber. Minimal fire behavior with smoldering. Residences threatened. Area closures in effect. 
 
Aspen Acres, Custer County. Twenty miles southwest of Pueblo, CO. Timber. Minimal fire behavior with 
backing and creeping. Communication infrastructure threatened. Area closures in effect. 
 
Willow, Pike and San Isabel NF, USFS. Six miles west of Leadville, CO. Brush, closed timber litter and timber. 
Minimal fire behavior. Communication infrastructure threatened. 
 
* Post, Las Animas County. Seven miles southeast of Trinidad, CO. Grass and brush. Active fire behavior with 
running and flanking. 
 
* Rancher, Pine Ridge Agency, BIA. Two miles east of Evergreen, SD. Timber. Active fire behavior with 
running. 
 
* XU Hill, Pine Ridge Agency, BIA. Twelve miles north of White River Ranger Station, SD. Grass and brush. 
Active fire behavior with wind-driven runs, running and flanking. Residences threatened. 
 
Cold Springs, Converse County. Seven miles southwest of Douglas, WY. Grass and brush. Moderate fire 
behavior. Numerous residences threatened. Last report unless significant activity occurs. 
 
310, Garfield County. One mile east of Battlement Mesa, CO. Brush, timber and dormant brush. No new 
information.
